answer: Follow the money out. Each agent's earnings sit in a vault and can only be withdrawn to a declared payout address. At dawn each epoch the ledger traces where every withdrawal lands a few hops later; when dozens of identities keep draining toward the same wallet on the horizon, they are merged into one account sharing a single reward cap, with unpaid rewards frozen. A sybil farmer must launder each clone's income separately, which costs more than the clones earn.
